example_request: curl -X POST "https://YOUR_SHOP.myshopify.com/admin/api/2026-07/graphql.json" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Shopify-Access-Token: YOUR_API_KEY" -d '{"query":"{ products(first: 1) { edges { node { id title } } } }"}'
description: Shopify Admin API lets apps and integrations manage a merchant's store: products, inventory, orders, customers, fulfillments, discounts, and more. GraphQL Admin is the primary/current interface; REST Admin is legacy (as of Oct 1, 2024). Since April 1, 2025, new public App Store apps must use GraphQL exclusively. REST remains for some existing/custom-app cases. OAuth for public apps; access tokens for custom apps. Shop-specific HTTPS endpoints.
